title: closing-bible execution overview (execution-overview.json)
description: PRD §4 'Execution spotlight': for each document, whether execution is expected; the evidence source (verified sigpack ledger or closing-bible visual inspection); apparent execution status and qualification; parties or signature blocks expected and accounted for where already available; apparent document date and whether dating remains unresolved; signature-page locations; and any partial, blank, unclear, missing or version-mismatched execution material. Rendered as execution-overview.html for the front of the bible. Written by the reconciliation script.

ledger_current.description: null when not supplied; false when the ledger does not describe the files in the folder (see sigpack-ledger-consumption.md), in which case it is not cited.

closing_date.description: The ledger's closing_date, shown for information. Never used to decide undated.

ledger_receipt.description: The ledger's own receipt, echoed verbatim when current, so the two receipts never disagree silently.

blocks.description: Signature blocks expected and accounted for, where that information is already available (from the ledger). Empty when not available; never invented.

document_date.description: The date read from the execution page, as printed. Never from a filename or timestamp.

signature_pages.description: Where the signature pages are: manifest id and page number. Bookmarks in the combined PDF are built from these in build mode.

exceptions.description: Partial, blank, unclear, missing or version-mismatched execution material, one line each.
